name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
benefit: Tuition and maintenance support for post-10th students
eligibility_text: SC students studying in a recognised post-matric course; family income within the prescribed limit
documents: Caste certificate; income certificate; previous marksheet; bank account; Aadhaar

name: Pre Matric Scholarship for SC Students
benefit: Financial support for students in classes 1 to 10
eligibility_text: SC students in recognised schools; family income within the prescribed limit
documents: Caste certificate; income certificate; school ID; bank account

name: Post Matric Scholarship for ST Students
benefit: Tuition and maintenance support for post-10th students
eligibility_text: ST students in recognised post-matric courses; family income within the prescribed limit
documents: ST certificate; income certificate; previous marksheet; bank account; Aadhaar

name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
benefit: Support for OBC students in post-matric courses
eligibility_text: OBC students in recognised courses; family income within the prescribed limit
documents: OBC certificate; income certificate; previous marksheet; bank account; Aadhaar

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa
benefit: Financial support for girls to stay in school and delay early marriage
eligibility_text: Unmarried girls from eligible West Bengal families meeting the scheme's age and income rules
documents: Birth certificate; income certificate; school or college ID; bank account; Aadhaar
